scope: These fixtures validate exploration navigation, not a personal recommendation, fit, hiring, admissions, income, health, legal, or identity conclusion.

pathPolicy.edgePolicy: Action-to-hobby may use a bidirectional semantic relation. Hobby-to-context must be an explicit exploration relation. Context-to-occupation must be an example_occupation edge; it is not an inference about a person.
pathPolicy.sourcePolicy: Every path edge needs non-empty sourceIds, rationaleKey, evidenceClass, provenance, and confidence.
pathPolicy.counterexample: A different hobby or work context can lead to a different exploration path; this fixture must not be presented as the only route or a ranking of people.
pathPolicy.uncertainty: Labels and graph links are starting points. Actual work varies by organization, location, regulation, role scope, qualifications, and current opportunities.

nextTwentyMinuteExperiment.noOutcomeClaim: An experiment records what to notice next; it does not prove ability, readiness, employability, health, or a career choice.

copy.ko: 20분 안에 멈출 수 있는 작은 시도를 해 보고, 흥미·불편함·필요한 정보를 한 줄로 기록하세요.
copy.en: Try a small experiment you can stop within 20 minutes, then note one interest, friction, or question.
copy.ja: 20分以内で止められる小さな試みをし、興味・負担・次に必要な情報を一行で記録します。
copy.zh: 尝试一个可在20分钟内停止的小实验，然后记下一项兴趣、阻力或待了解的问题。
copy.fr: Faites une petite expérience que vous pouvez arrêter en 20 minutes, puis notez un intérêt, un frein ou une question.
copy.es: Prueba un experimento pequeño que puedas detener en 20 minutos y anota un interés, una fricción o una pregunta.
